title: Motor Trend cars
techniques: descriptives; correlation; one-sample tests; linear and binary models; model comparison; scatterplot; matrix; parallel coordinates; boxplot; histogram; bar chart
analysis_objective: Explore relations among fuel economy and vehicle design, then compare descriptive and regression views.
citation: Henderson & Velleman (1981), Biometrics 37, 391-411; R datasets: mtcars.

title: Anscombe's quartet
techniques: linear models and diagnostics; grouped scatterplots; Trellis scatterplots
analysis_objective: Show why plots and diagnostics are essential even when regression summaries are almost identical.
citation: Anscombe (1973), The American Statistician 27, 17-21; R datasets: anscombe.

title: New York air quality
techniques: missing-data overview and imputation; time series; scatterplot; histogram
analysis_objective: Explore environmental time patterns and the consequences of incomplete measurements.
citation: Chambers et al. (1983), Graphical Methods for Data Analysis; R datasets: airquality.

title: Chick growth
techniques: time series; Trellis plots; grouped scatterplots; linear models
analysis_objective: Compare individual growth trajectories over time and assess differences among diets.
citation: Crowder & Hand (1990), Analysis of Repeated Measures, Example 5.3; R datasets: ChickWeight.

title: Iris flowers
techniques: correlation; PCA/factor analysis; quick cluster; scatterplot matrix; parallel coordinates; grouped plots
analysis_objective: Explore multivariate separation of three iris species.
citation: Fisher (1936), Annals of Eugenics 7, 179-188; R datasets: iris.

title: Paired sleep data
analysis_objective: Estimate the paired change in sleep produced by two drugs.
citation: Cushny & Peebles (1905); Student (1908); R datasets: sleep.

title: Guinea-pig tooth growth
techniques: two-sample tests; one-way ANOVA; factorial linear models; interaction interpretation; boxplot; bar chart; Trellis plots
analysis_objective: Compare tooth growth across supplement types and vitamin C doses.
citation: Crampton (1947), Journal of Nutrition 33, 491-504; R datasets: ToothGrowth.

title: US arrests
techniques: correlation; PCA/factor analysis; quick cluster; scatterplot matrix; parallel coordinates
analysis_objective: Explore multivariate differences in violent-crime indicators among US states.
citation: McNeil (1977), Interactive Data Analysis; R datasets: USArrests.

title: Warp breaks
techniques: count models: Poisson and negative-binomial; factorial interactions; boxplot; bar chart; Trellis plots
analysis_objective: Model overdispersed counts of loom breaks by wool type and tension.
citation: Tippett (1950), Technological Applications of Statistics; R datasets: warpbreaks.

title: Titanic passengers
techniques: contingency tables; binary models; interactions; bar charts; Table 1
analysis_objective: Study associations among passenger class, sex, age, and survival.
citation: Dawson (1995), Journal of Statistics Education 3; R datasets: Titanic.

title: School absence
techniques: Poisson and negative-binomial models; interactions; boxplot; histogram
analysis_objective: Model counts of school absences from pupil characteristics.
citation: Quine, cited in Aitkin (1978), JRSS A 141, 195-223; MASS: quine.

title: Car insurance claims
techniques: Poisson models with an offset; model comparison; categorical predictors
analysis_objective: Model insurance claim rates while accounting for the number of exposed policyholders.
citation: Baxter, Coutts & Ross (1980), 21st International Congress of Actuaries; MASS: Insurance.

title: Gasoline yield
techniques: beta proportion models; linear models; regression diagnostics; scatterplot
analysis_objective: Model a bounded gasoline-yield proportion and inspect regression diagnostics.

title: Theophylline concentration
techniques: positive-continuous models; time series; Trellis plots; grouped scatterplots
analysis_objective: Describe concentration over time and between-subject pharmacokinetic variation.
citation: Boeckmann, Sheiner & Beal (1994), NONMEM Users Guide; R datasets: Theoph.

title: Big Five personality items
techniques: scale analysis; correlation; PCA/factor analysis; missing data; Table 1
analysis_objective: Evaluate scale reliability and the five-factor structure of personality items.
citation: Goldberg (1999) and Revelle, Wilt & Rosenthal (2010); psych: bfi.

title: NHANES with missing values
analysis_objective: Explore missing-data patterns and practice imputation.
citation: Schafer (1997), Analysis of Incomplete Multivariate Data, Table 6.14; mice: nhanes2.

title: NHANES multiple imputation
techniques: multiple-imputation analyses, pooled models, diagnostics, plots, and tables
analysis_objective: Fit and diagnose analyses pooled across multiple imputations.
citation: Schafer (1997), Analysis of Incomplete Multivariate Data, Table 6.14; mice: nhanes2.
